newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle steady/up $0.50 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle steady/up $0.50 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers steady to $0.50 higher in a narrow test. Offerings very light due to storm and tornado warnings accompanied by high winds throughout Monday evening and early Tuesday morning. - USDA
Slaughter Steers: High Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1350 lbs 63.50-64.50. Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 62.50-63.50. Select 1-2 61.50-62.50.
Slaughter Heifers: High Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1200 lbs 63.00-64.00. Select and Choice 2-3 950-1100 lbs 62.00-63.00.
